en.headline: Government rejects US trafficking report on Hong Kong
en.dek: A spokesman called Hong Kong's Tier 3 ranking in the 2026 US Trafficking in Persons Report unfounded, and said screening last year identified 15 victims.
body: The Hong Kong government said on Friday it strongly opposed comments on the city in the United States State Department's 2026 Trafficking in Persons Report.

A government spokesman said the decision to place Hong Kong in Tier 3 was completely unfounded. The spokesman said trafficking in persons had never been a prevalent problem in Hong Kong, and that there was no sign the city was being used as a destination or transit point by criminal groups.

The spokesman said departments continued last year to screen people they came into contact with who were more likely to face a trafficking risk. Of about 12,100 preliminary screenings, 15 victims were identified. All were Hong Kong residents who had fallen for job scams in Southeast Asian countries, and they were helped to return safely, the spokesman said.

On criticism of the two-week rule for foreign domestic helpers, the spokesman said the measure was meant to maintain effective immigration control, and that the report did not mention similar departure deadlines in the United States visa system. The government also said existing laws already covered trafficking conduct, and that a single dedicated statute was not required.

zh.headline: 政府反對美國販運人口報告對港評級
zh.dek: 發言人指《2026年美國販運人口報告》把香港列為第三級別毫無根據，並稱去年約12100次初步識別審核中識別15名受害者。
body: 特區政府周五表示，強烈反對美國國務院《2026年販運人口報告》中關於香港的評論。
政府發言人說，報告把香港評為第三級別完全毫無根據。發言人又說，販運人口在香港從來不是普遍問題，亦沒有跡象顯示犯罪集團以香港作為目的地或中轉站。
發言人表示，各部門去年繼續對接觸到、而較可能涉及販運人口風險的人士進行初步識別審核。約12100次審核中識別15名受害者，全部是墮入東南亞國家求職騙案的香港居民，政府已協助他們安全回港。
就報告對外傭「兩星期規則」的說法，發言人說有關措施旨在維持有效入境管制，報告亦沒有提及美國簽證制度同樣設有離境時限。政府又指，現行法例已涵蓋各類販運人口行為，不一定要另立單一專法。
